HMCTS Civil Business Centre performance information

Details of processing or reply times for work at the County Court Business Centre (Northampton).

From:
HM Courts & Tribunals Service
Published:
19 September 2017
Last updated:
26 August 2026 — See all updates

Documents

Weekly performance national business centre updated 26 August 2026

HTML

Details

Check the processing times on this page before contacting the business centre to ask about the progress of a case.

You can contact:

  • the Money Claim Online Helpdesk by emailing MCOLITassistance@justice.gov.uk or on 0300 123 1056
  • the County Court Business Centre by emailing MCOLITassistance@justice.gov.uk or on 0300 123 1056
  • the Civil National Business Centre

The County Court Business Centre is responsible for issuing new claims filed by paper and processing Attachment of Earnings and Charging Orders. If you have any queries about these, contact us on 0300 123 1356.
